tasks.short: Draw biofuel and by-product samples for quality control

steps.what: Read the sampling order and identify the actual product or by-product batch
Draw the specified biofuel product or secondary by-product sample
outputs: drawn sample and observed collection details

steps.what: Record the actual sampling time, point, batch and collection exceptions
inputs: drawn sample and observed collection details

steps.what: Prepare and affix the sample identification label
inputs: drawn sample and observed collection details

steps.what: Verify the labelled sample against the actual batch and approve the record and laboratory destination
outputs: approved sample and collection record v1 with laboratory destination

steps.what: Save the approved collection record in the current sample record
inputs: approved sample and collection record v1 with laboratory destination

steps.what: Hand the approved labelled sample to the laboratory collection route
inputs: approved sample and collection record v1 with laboratory destination
outputs: sample handed over for quality control testing

tasks.design: Configure sample-order defaults and label preparation in {OPS_SYSTEM}; {OTHER} includes the physical sampling equipment and label printer. The manager still draws the sample, enters actual collection details, affixes and verifies its label and hands it over.
tasks.previous_blocker: Sample identities and order details can require repeated entry when recording and labelling.
tasks.enabler_now: Native sample forms can reuse order fields and prepare labels from actual confirmed collection records.
tasks.still_hard: Collect a representative uncontaminated sample and preserve identity.

ambition.what: Reduce sample paperwork while retaining physical sampling and identity checks.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: sample systems can reuse order identifiers and prepare labels while people retain collection, affixing and verification.

assumptions: Boundary includes sample collection, collection record, label and handover, not laboratory testing.

Existing quality staff supply sample order ID, required product/test and container requirements. s1 verifies actual batch identity. s3 counts capture of actual time, point, collector, batch, exceptions and observed condition; these never come from planned sampling time. Missing identifiers require manual entry and verification.

Native sample forms and labels come first. Central removes 25% of repeated order-field entry and 40% of label preparation effort only; physical collection, affixing, verification and handover are retained. Printing runtime is excluded from human baseline.
Same-record save is effectively zero; minimum 1 is fully retained. Approval is after record and label exist; changes void both gates.
Provisional B=100, R=93, gross=7; focal incremental=0.5; net=6.5, independent of means priors.
unknowns: Current repeated entry and label preparation effort
research_questions: Trace samples from collection to laboratory receipt and time actual capture and affixing separately.

already_counted.description: Verify the actual sample, final label and collection record

incremental.description: Check sample-template and label mapping changes

approvals.approved_version: approved sample and collection record v1 with laboratory destination
approved sample and collection record v1 with laboratory destination

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: sample forms and labels already reuse identifiers. High: seven gross hours require two extra exception hours and 0.5 upkeep hours, leaving 4.5.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Approve biofuels equipment and process proposals

steps.what: Gather the submitted proposal, equipment history and supporting cost and process evidence
inputs: existing acquisition, repair, replacement or process proposal
outputs: proposal evidence pack with missing items

steps.what: Assess the proposal's technical, production and financial trade-offs
inputs: proposal evidence pack with missing items

steps.what: Resolve proposal questions with engineering, maintenance and process owners
outputs: resolved proposal assessment and remaining conditions

steps.what: Record and approve the decision on the final proposal revision and its conditions
inputs: resolved proposal assessment and remaining conditions
existing acquisition, repair, replacement or process proposal
outputs: approved proposal decision v1 bound to proposal revision

steps.what: Commit the approved proposal decision to the current approval record
inputs: approved proposal decision v1 bound to proposal revision

tasks.design: Link proposal evidence in {ERP}, {OPS_SYSTEM} and {DOCS} so the manager can gather a revision-specific pack. The manager assesses the proposal, resolves questions and records the decision; no acquisition or process change is executed by the tool.
tasks.previous_blocker: Proposal evidence can be dispersed across equipment, process and finance records.
tasks.enabler_now: Native proposal links can expose existing supporting records.
tasks.still_hard: Judge process suitability and the consequences of approving a proposal.
tasks.human_edge: Accept or reject the proposal with accountable conditions.

ambition.what: Reduce evidence gathering before a human proposal decision.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: revision-linked proposal records can gather supporting evidence without deciding approval.

assumptions: Boundary is approving a submitted proposal, including decision recording. Developing the proposal, procuring equipment and changing the process are separate work.

Existing proposal owners supply proposal ID/revision, asset/process ID, requested action, quantities, cost basis, risk analysis and evidence references. Existing asset owners supply actual maintenance history. Missing references require enquiries counted in s1/s3, not free new staff entry. s4 counts decision, conditions and rationale capture.
Use native proposal evidence links first. Central reduces gathering by 30% only; assessment, consultation and decision writing stay at 100%.
Same-record commit is effectively zero; minimum 1 earns no saving. The final decision is bound to the final proposal revision; any revision change requires renewed review.
Provisional B=100, R=94, gross=6; focal incremental=0.5; net=5.5, independent of means priors.
unknowns: Gathering effort and missing evidence frequency
research_questions: Inspect proposal revision histories and time evidence gathering separately from evaluation.

incremental.description: Check evidence-link failures after system changes

approvals.approved_version: approved proposal decision v1 bound to proposal revision

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: native proposal records already expose the evidence. High: six hours of reduced gathering require 1.5 extra missing-link hours and 0.5 upkeep hours, leaving four.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Prepare and manage biofuels plant budgets

steps.what: Gather actual feedstock, energy, chemical, staffing and by-product revenue records
inputs: existing actual plant costs and revenue
existing actual production and usage records

steps.what: Choose budget assumptions for feedstock mix, yields, prices and operating availability
Assemble plant or unit budget scenarios from the selected assumptions
Prepare actual-versus-budget comparisons during budget management
inputs: existing later actual cost and production records

steps.what: Resolve budget variances and approve the final budget or revised budget with rationale
outputs: approved biofuels budget v1 and variance decisions

steps.what: Save the approved budget and variance decisions in the current budget record
inputs: approved biofuels budget v1 and variance decisions

tasks.design: Configure actual cost and production views from {ERP} and {OPS_SYSTEM} to support budget scenarios in {SPREADSHEET} and variance views in {BI}. The manager chooses yield and price assumptions, judges variances and approves the completed budget or revision.
tasks.previous_blocker: Feedstock, utility and by-product records can require manual period and unit reconciliation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native budgeting and deterministic mappings can assemble supported inputs and comparisons.
tasks.still_hard: Choose assumptions when feedstock quality, yields and prices vary.

ambition.what: Revisit plant budgets when actual yields or costs change.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: actual production and finance records can feed deterministic budget scenarios and variance views.

assumptions: Boundary covers budget preparation and management through approved revisions; it excludes executing resulting purchases or staffing changes.

Existing operators record actual batch/output, feedstock and energy quantities with units and times; finance records cost/revenue, account, period and currency. s1 reconciles these. s2 counts capture of future volume, mix, yield, availability and price assumptions. Later actuals in s4 are existing closed-period records, not planned values.

Native budget tools come first. Central reduces only human gathering, scenario assembly and variance preparation; existing arithmetic runtime is excluded. Missing period/unit mappings are handled in the retained portions.
Same-system save is effectively zero; minimum 1 is retained. Approval follows the completed revision and any edit voids it.
Provisional B=100, R=68, gross=32; focal upkeep=1; net=31. Shares are independent of means priors.
unknowns: Actual reconciliation and scenario assembly effort
research_questions: Reconcile a budget revision to actual production, invoices and by-product sales and time manual handling.

already_counted.description: Resolve actual-cost and production input mismatches

incremental.description: Maintain unit/period mappings and audit budget-view completeness

approvals.approved_version: approved biofuels budget v1 and variance decisions

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: native budgeting already supplies all comparisons. High: 32 gross points face seven extra period/unit exception hours and one upkeep hour, leaving 24.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Study biofuels production cost, materials and efficiency

steps.what: Define the study boundary, comparison basis and efficiency questions
Collect actual material, energy, output and cost records for the study periods
inputs: existing actual production and cost records

steps.what: Reconcile material balances, unit costs and efficiency comparisons
outputs: checked study comparisons and unresolved balance anomalies

steps.what: Investigate anomalies and record conclusions about cost, materials and efficiency
inputs: checked study comparisons and unresolved balance anomalies
outputs: study conclusions, causal limits and improvement findings

steps.what: Assemble, validate and approve the study report with the manager's conclusions
inputs: checked study comparisons and unresolved balance anomalies
study conclusions, causal limits and improvement findings

steps.what: Save the approved study in the current study record

tasks.design: Map existing actual {OPS_SYSTEM} and {ERP} records into traceable {SPREADSHEET} study comparisons and a {DOCS} report template. The manager defines the comparison basis, resolves balance anomalies and checks the final report; no model supplies causal explanations.
tasks.previous_blocker: Study records can differ in units, period boundaries and cost allocation.
tasks.enabler_now: Deterministic mapping and source-linked comparisons can reduce repeated assembly and matching.
tasks.still_hard: Distinguish real efficiency changes from feedstock or measurement differences.
tasks.human_edge: Set a fair comparison and judge causal limits.

ambition.what: Repeat focused efficiency studies with consistent source traceability.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: source-linked material and cost comparisons can be assembled deterministically, while causal interpretation requires process knowledge.

assumptions: Boundary includes conducting and documenting the study; it excludes new trials, purchasing or process changes.

Existing operators and meters supply batch/period, actual input/output mass, energy, losses, units and quality flags; finance supplies actual cost allocations and currency. s2 resolves missing records manually. If new measurements are needed, re-estimate the study instead of treating them as free inputs. s1 captures scope and comparison definitions; s4 captures conclusions and uncertainties.

Check native process and cost reports first. Central savings concern input gathering, repeated matching and report formatting only; solver runtime, physical observation and causal judgement earn no saving. s5 retains 8.4 hours for final meaning and source validation.
Same-document save is effectively zero; minimum 1 is retained. Approval follows completed assembly and edits void it.
Provisional B=100, R=78.4, gross=21.6; focal upkeep=1.1; net=20.5. Shares are independent of means priors.
unknowns: Comparable actual records and native study reports
research_questions: Replay one study with its original source records and count all reconciliation and report correction time.

incremental.description: Maintain unit/cost allocation mappings and study templates

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: native study reports already cover the work. High: 21.6 gross points require 5.5 extra reconciliation/correction hours and 1.1 upkeep hours, leaving 15.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

Bind decisions to final proposal revisions
